hooks.command:
{ cur=$(git rev-parse HEAD); state=".git/claude-readme-check-last"; prev=$(cat "$state" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$cur" ] && [ "$cur" != "$prev" ]; then echo "$cur" > "$state"; files=$(git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r "$cur" | grep -v '^README\.md$'); if [ -n "$files" ]; then jq -n --arg files "$files" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:("A new commit was just made in this repo. Changed files (README.md was not among them):
" + $files + "

Check whether README.md needs updating to reflect this change (new commands, architecture, scripts, env vars, or workflow changes). If not significant, no action needed.")}}'; fi; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
